verdict.rationale: LobeHub's development docs point to a public REST API with an OpenAPI specification, authentication and parameters, plus an official `@lobehub/sdk` generated from that spec. A probe confirmed a live openapi.json at lobehub.com. missing for 10: evidence of which product operations the API covers (agents, tasks, topics), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Integrate through HTTP | [OpenAPI specification]... Use the public REST API, authentication, and parameters supported by the target deployment.
`@lobehub/sdk` is generated from OpenAPI. Follow the matching README and specification for methods, authentication, and streaming.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://lobehub.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
